source: Microsoft Learn Azure built-in roles and Key Vault RBAC guidance

roles.name: Key Vault Administrator
roles.intent: Perform all data-plane operations on keys, secrets, and certificates except RBAC role assignment management.

roles.name: Key Vault Reader
roles.intent: Read metadata for vault objects without reading secret values or private key material.

roles.name: Key Vault Secrets Officer
roles.intent: Perform any action on secrets except permission management.

roles.name: Key Vault Crypto User
roles.intent: Read key metadata and perform cryptographic operations.

roles.name: Key Vault Crypto Officer
roles.intent: Perform any action on keys except permission management.

roles.name: Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User
roles.intent: Read key metadata and perform wrap/unwrap operations.

roles.name: Key Vault Crypto Service Release User
Key Vault Certificate User
roles.intent: Read certificate contents, including related secret/key read permissions needed for certificate material.

roles.name: Key Vault Certificates Officer
roles.intent: Perform any action on certificates except permission management.

roles.name: Key Vault Purge Operator
roles.intent: Purge soft-deleted vaults. Treat as privileged break-glass/admin access.
